# Scheme

Uses polish notation for operator:

``` {racket}
(+ 1 2 3)
```

Function composition:

``` {racket}
(* (+ 1 2 3) (- 3 2))
```

Evaluates from inside to outside:

``` {racket}
(* (+ 1 2 3) (- 3 2))
```

Get SICP. Sleep over it.

(Class give credits if the weakest of a group get better grades.
Nice incentive.)

Don't cut corners.
Life is made of habits.
Get good habits.
Don't cheat.

Define a function:

``` {racket}
(define (square x)
 (* x x))
```

`x` is the *parameter*.
`(* x x)` is the *body*.
If I call `(square 2)`, `2` is the *argument*.

``` {lisp}
(define (plural wd)
 (if (equal? (last wd) 'y)
  (word (butlast wd) 'is)
  (word wd 's)))
```

We can use *recursion*, for *pig Latin*:

``` {lisp}
(define (pigl wd)
 (if (member? (first wd) '(a e i o u))
     (word wd 'ay)
     (pigl (word (bf wd) (fisrt wd)))))
```
